items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Milt Buckner? ... I'm just bad at these names far back.

ctx.x: At that time? That's when I, Barney Bigard, what's his name organ.
Barney Bigard, Money Johnson, Chambers, another organ player around there. I'm just bad at these names far back. I must be getting old.
